rows.deployment_name: Figure 02 at BMW Group Plant Spartanburg body shop
rows.site_or_region: BMW Group Plant Spartanburg, South Carolina, USA
rows.source_status_as_written: The world's first deployment of humanoid robots at a BMW Group plant took place at the Spartanburg plant in the United States in 2025, in collaboration with the technology company Figure AI. ... rows.deployment_name: Figure 03 sequencing at BMW Group Plant Spartanburg Hall 52
rows.site_or_region: Hall 52, BMW Group Plant Spartanburg, South Carolina, USA
rows.source_status_as_written: Following a successful deployment with the humanoid robot Figure 02 at BMW Group Plant Spartanburg in the USA, the further-developed successor, Figure 03, will now start at Spartanburg, working on complex sequencing applications in logistics.

rows.deployment_name: Hexagon AEON pilot at BMW Group Plant Leipzig
rows.site_or_region: BMW Group Plant Leipzig, Germany
